title: 第9章 我就住几天
novel_title: 听我解释，真不是你们想的那样！
content_zh:
因为王峰师兄，对他也是恩重如山！

    他是五行灵根，修行所需要的资源，远超一般人想象！那为什么他的修为提升的还是这么快？

    还不是因为王峰和他背后的炼丹王家！

    并且在他练气突破筑基的关头，师尊胡伟去求极品筑基丹，却根本就没人理他，还是王家，因为王峰的求情，这才给了他一颗上品筑基丹，让他有了突破筑基的可能！

    “那师姐你……”

    “我今天来,只是想确认。”姜怀玉擦去眼泪,重新看向他,目光里多了一丝莫名的意味。

    她一开始来找陆沉，也许是想要一个答案，也许是想要一个可以恨的人。

    可真的见到他,看到他慌乱的样子,看到他眼底的愧疚和痛苦,她忽然发现她恨不起来。

    因为他也是受害者。

    他和她一样,什么都不知道。

    就被命运玩弄于股掌之间。

    只是，她和他之间，毕竟有着……

    并且这几天，她在王家的遭遇待遇，遭遇到的冷眼……

    一想起来这些，姜怀玉就满脸痛苦。

    而看到同样神情痛苦的姜怀玉，陆沉心里也不得劲。

    “是我。”

    “当初我在合欢宗，也只是个炉鼎，所做的一切，我都只能眼睁睁看着！”

    想起过往的经历，陆沉脸上闪过一丝痛苦。

    随后，他又开始狠狠的抽自己巴掌。

    “是我无能，我毁了你们一家，我真的该死！”

    见到陆沉意志消沉，姜怀玉连忙扑过去，抓住他的双臂，不让他惩罚自己。

    “你是受害者，师姐也是受害者，师姐不怪你的，不许这么对自己了！”

    这情景，反而是姜怀玉安慰起了陆沉。

    “师姐,我……”陆沉想说什么,却发现自己的声音干涩得厉害。

    “我没有怪你，我也只是想知道答案。”

    “嗯。”

    陆沉冷静下来,觉得很是尴尬,于是只能默默无言。

    可姜怀玉却没有挪动一下屁股。

    两人就这么坐着,靠得很近,近到能听见彼此的呼吸声。
content_en:
Because Senior Brother Wang Feng was also very kind to him!

He is the spiritual root of the Five Elements, and the resources required for cultivation are far beyond what ordinary people imagine!Then why did his cultivation improve so quickly?

It’s not because of Wang Feng and the alchemy Wang family behind him!

And when he was practicing Qi and breaking through the Foundation Establishment, Master Hu Wei went to ask for the top-grade Foundation Establishment Pill, but no one paid any attention to him. It was the Wang family who, because of Wang Feng's plea, gave him a top-grade Foundation Establishment Pill, giving him the possibility of breaking through the Foundation Establishment!

"Then senior sister, you..."

"I came today just to confirm." Jiang Huaiyu wiped away his tears and looked at him again, with an inexplicable meaning in his eyes.

She came to Lu Chen at first, maybe because she wanted an answer, maybe because she wanted someone to hate.

But when she really saw him, saw his panicked look, saw the guilt and pain in his eyes, she suddenly found that she couldn't hate him.

Because he is also a victim.

Like her, he knew nothing.

Just being played with by fate.

But, after all, there was something between her and him...

And in the past few days, the treatment she had received at the Wang family, the cold looks she had received...

Jiang Huaiyu's face was full of pain when he thought of this.

Seeing Jiang Huaiyu with the same painful expression, Lu Chen felt unhappy.

"It's me."

"When I was in the Hehuan Sect, I was just a furnace. Everything I did, I could only watch helplessly!"

Thinking of past experiences, a trace of pain flashed across Lu Chen's face.

Then, he started to slap himself hard again.

"I am incompetent, I ruined your family, I really deserve to die!"

Seeing Lu Chen's despondency, Jiang Huaiyu rushed over and grabbed his arms to prevent him from punishing her.

"You are a victim, and senior sister is also a victim. Senior sister doesn't blame you. Don't do this to yourself!"

In this scene, it was Jiang Huaiyu who comforted Lu Chen.

"Senior sister, I..." Lu Chen wanted to say something, but found that his voice was extremely dry.

"I don't blame you, I just want to know the answer."

"Yeah."

Lu Chen calmed down and felt very embarrassed, so he could only remain silent.

But Jiang Huaiyu didn't move his buttocks.

The two of them just sat like this, so close that they could hear each other's breathing.
title_en: Chapter 9 I will stay for a few days
